InCost 0.9.47 — програма, яка знає ваш цех

🎁 14 днів Pro безкоштовно — вкажіть email у «Налаштування → Ліцензія», ключ прийде листом. Там же — «Купити Pro».
🔁 «Ця деталь у вас уже була» — відкрили DXF, який уже рахували: стара ціна, клієнт, що змінилось і чому, «Повторити замовлення» одним кліком.
📚 Шаблони цеху (Проєкти → Шаблони цеху) — типові деталі з ціною на сьогодні й прайс послуг (доставка, розробка креслення, монтаж): у пропозицію одним кліком.
🎯 Точність цеху — після 3 записів факту видно, наскільки точно InCost рахує час саме у вас: «±4 % за 20 замовлень».
📅 Тиждень у цеху (Проєкти → Тиждень) — хто переглянув пропозицію й чекає дзвінка, які ціни застаріли, що виграли; звіт копіюється одним кліком.
🛠 Свої операції цеху — фарбування за м², цинкування за кг, зачищення за метр кромки: задайте один раз, вибирайте галочкою — і вони в ціні та маршрутній карті.
⚙️ Симуляція різання з розгоном і кутами — головка гальмує на кутах і дрібних отворах, як справжній верстат; за бажанням цей час іде в ціну.
📐 Креслення з 3D точніше — отвори в брусках і фланцях з розмірами й позначками («12 отв. Ø22»), точні діаметри, правильний переріз, зрозуміле повідомлення, якщо види не вміщуються на формат.

InCost 0.9.47 — the app that knows your shop

🎁 14 days of Pro free — enter your email in Settings → License, the key arrives by email. "Buy Pro" is there too.
🔁 "You have quoted this part before" — open a DXF you already quoted: old price, customer, what changed and why, repeat the order in one click.
📚 Shop templates (Projects → Shop templates) — standard parts at today's price and a service price list (delivery, drawing preparation, installation): into a quote in one click.
🎯 Shop accuracy — after 3 actual-time records you see how accurately InCost estimates time in your shop: "±4% over 20 orders".
📅 Week in the shop (Projects → Week) — who viewed your quote and is waiting for a call, which prices are outdated, what you won; copy the report in one click.
🛠 Your shop operations — painting per m², galvanizing per kg, deburring per metre of edge: set once, tick when needed — they go into the price and the routing card.
⚙️ Cutting simulation with acceleration and corners — the head slows down on corners and small holes like a real machine; optionally use this time in the price.
📐 Better drawings from 3D — holes in blocks and flanges dimensioned and called out ("12× Ø22"), exact diameters, correct section, a clear message when views don't fit the sheet.
notes.pl:
## What's new

**🎁 14 days of Pro for free.** Enter your email in *Settings → License* — a Pro key for 14 days arrives by email. Plus a *Buy Pro* button right in the app.

**🔁 "You have quoted this part before."** Open a DXF you already quoted and InCost shows when, for whom, how many and at what price — what the same quantity costs today and why (material price, cost items), the markup that would keep the old price, how that quote ended. *Repeat order* in one click. Rotated drawings are recognised too.

**📚 Shop templates.** *Projects → Shop templates*: save the parts you quote again and again as standard parts — InCost shows the price you had and the price today (full recalculation with current material prices and rates), and adds the part to a quotation in one click. Keep a price list of your services — drawing preparation per hour, delivery per trip, installation, packaging — and add them to a quotation as separate lines with their own unit.

**🎯 Shop accuracy.** Enter the actual time after a job — after 3 records InCost shows its typical error in *your* shop ("±4.8%", "11 of 12 orders within ±10%"), compared with no correction, plus a warning if estimates are systematically high or low.

**📅 Week in the shop.** *Projects → Week*: estimates and quotes vs last week, won and lost, quotes viewed via the link and waiting for your call (hottest first), materials with default or outdated prices, exchange rate. Copy the report as text in one click. Everything is calculated on your computer.

**🛠 Your shop operations.** Painting per m² (one or both sides), galvanizing per kg, edge deburring per metre of cut, marking per piece, finishing per hour — set them once in *Shop equipment*, tick them in *Sheet & cutting*, and they go into the price, the cost breakdown and the routing card.

**⚙️ Serious cutting simulation.** Acceleration, braking, slowing down on corners (corner tolerance) and arcs (√(a·R)), stops at every contour — with machine parameters per technology. See the time the machine really needs, the current head speed and how much time small holes cost. Optionally use this time in the price.

**📐 Better drawings from 3D models.** Tested on 179 STEP models (plates, blocks, shafts, flanges, brackets, shells, assemblies, rotated and inch models): holes in blocks and flanges are now dimensioned and called out ("12× Ø22" with the bolt-circle diameter), diameters and overall sizes come from exact geometry, the section is placed where it matters, broken files are handled gracefully, and you get a clear message when views don't fit the chosen sheet and scale.

Also: release notes in Help (*What's new*), more EN/PL translations, accuracy and stability fixes.

**Windows 10/11, 64-bit.** Unzip and run `InCost.exe`. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click *More info → Run anyway*. Existing users get this update inside the app.

---
